question: I'm an IS sophomore. In Fall 2025, I'd like to take 67-262 (Section 4: Sun/Tue 10:00–11:15) and 15-150 (Section W: Thu/Tue/Sun 14:30–15:45). Do these two courses conflict?
expected_answer: No — 67-262 Section 4 meets Sunday and Tuesday 10:00–11:15, and 15-150 Section W meets Thursday, Tuesday, and Sunday 14:30–15:45. While they share Tuesday and Sunday as meeting days, the time slots do not overlap: 10:00–11:15 and 14:30–15:45 are separated by over 3 hours. No conflict.
reasoning_type: Shared-day but non-overlapping times — no conflict
common_mistake: Flagging a conflict because both courses share Tuesday and Sunday without checking whether the time windows overlap
needs_verification: Note: P-013 may not meet the prerequisite for 15-150 (needs 15-112 C and a math prereq), so this is primarily a schedule question
